'''Duro-plastic''' was a material<ref name="PF">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Plant Food|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref> that was used to make furniture such as chairs.<ref name="AP">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref> A long yellow [[Tuber/Legends|tuber]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Binaros]] was nutritious, but was described as bland, crunchy, and eating it was likened to chewing on duro-plastic.<ref name="PF" />
